actions.action: Bind approvals to exact paragraph revisions
actions.mechanism: Approval records identify both source and translation revisions; publication rejects mismatches rather than trusting an approved flag.
actions.implementation: Store immutable paragraph revisions and approval tuples containing language, stable IDs, revision IDs, and reviewer. Check tuples atomically during publication.
actions.check: Edit a source paragraph after approval: publication must fail. An unchanged paragraph must retain its valid approval.
actions.risk: Restoring earlier wording must not silently restore approval.

actions.mechanism: A compact change list directs attention, while expandable comparisons preserve details needed to judge translation accuracy.
actions.implementation: Compare the last approved source with the current revision by stable ID. Show source and translation differences, movement, and surrounding paragraphs.
actions.check: Use moved, unchanged, and substantively edited paragraphs: identify movement separately, exclude unchanged content from the change queue, and expose every edit.
actions.risk: Collapsed details can hide consequential punctuation or context.

actions.action: Track context that can invalidate unchanged translations
actions.mechanism: Explicit context dependencies catch translations affected by changed headings, references, or placement even when their source wording stays identical.
actions.implementation: Record relevant heading, terminology, and reference dependencies. Flag dependent translations when these change; flag moved paragraphs for human context confirmation before publication.
actions.check: Move a paragraph beneath a contradictory heading: publication must pause for context review. Unrelated unchanged paragraphs must remain approved.
actions.risk: Missing dependencies can leave indirect effects undetected.

actions.action: Allocate bounded review batches between two volunteers
actions.mechanism: One shared queue prevents duplicate effort; pinned review batches prevent approvals from drifting onto newer revisions.
actions.implementation: Per language, assign each affected paragraph to one volunteer and route disputed items to the other. Pin revisions; supersede tasks after further edits.
actions.check: Have both volunteers claim one task: only one succeeds. Edit during review: the old approval must not clear the replacement task.
actions.risk: Disagreements remain blocked until resolved; workload may become uneven.
